meta.title: AZnet Theme UPN3 — Disposable WordPress QA

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( ! function_exists( 'putenv' ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'UPN3 requires putenv for explicit disposable-only test gate.' );
}
putenv( 'AZT_UPN3_DISPOSABLE=YES_DISPOSABLE' );
putenv( 'AZT_UPN3_EXPECT_BLOB=a3f118fb987aad11e7072475dfd80e1ac16c4d37' );
require WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/themes/aznet-theme/tests/wordpress/upn3-readonly-update-notice.php';
